name: Barabbas
overview: The Scriptures present Barabbas as a notable prisoner whom Pilate offered to release to the gathered crowd instead of Jesus Christ. Despite Pilate's awareness of Jesus' innocence and his wife's warning to avoid condemning the 'just man,' the chief priests and elders persuaded the people to choose Barabbas. This choice highlights the rejection of the righteous Savior in favor of a guilty man, underscoring the injustice surrounding Christ's crucifixion.
